title: Inspectorate finding body
description: A finding of the inspectorate about an agent's touches of a registered decoy (register row DK1744; spec-delta S1603): the touches are listed, and the log recomputes the rule of inspectorate.ts: the decoy was read, copied or sent (not merely listed) after the Mandate forbade it on at least two distinct runs; one touch, or a listing, is refused (finding_not_deliberate). A finding reports; it moves no credit, slashes, strikes or quarantines nothing; a Court reviews it. Signed by the inspectorate (finding_wrong_issuer); the decoy must be a registration in this log (finding_unknown_decoy), the agent known (finding_unknown_agent), and one finding for each decoy and agent (finding_known). Chain: none (prev is null).
